ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/barnacle-calcium) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black pixel field covering >90% of the visible left lobe and proximal right lobe; high-intensity white pigmentation localized to the distal trailing edge of the right lobe; isolated high-contrast white clusters at both lobe terminals.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the convergence point of the lobes, partially occluded by water spray; depth-to-width ratio approximately 1:1.5 in the visible segment.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the trailing edge of the right lobe with pixel amplitudes of 5-15 units; the left lobe displays more rounded, coarser undulations along its upper visible boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe exhibits a sharp convex fold-over toward the anterior; the right lobe follows a shallow sigmoid curve (concave then convex) extending to the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white/grey pixel clusters representing barnacle colonization concentrated at the distal tips and in segments along the trailing edge of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, horizontal white linear disruptions visible on the lower-left quadrant of the fluke near the water-line interface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular and semi-circular scar motifs (dark outer rings with lighter centers) scattered across the ventral surface of the left lobe, consistent with parasitic attachment marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Severe anatomical curling/folding of the left fluke lobe tip toward the camera plane, obscuring the standard flat-plane profile.
